top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and its active form are a mature, clinically transformative achievement: Holst's and Mojsov's identification of the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and Drucker's work on its physiology and gut/pancreas actions made incretin-based treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity possible, with large-scale outcome evidence. The three-laureate allocation and a citation scoped to the physiology and active form of GLP-1 is defensible, and P000 is clearly worse than awarding a discovery of this maturity and impact.
